name: My Grandpa Is a BL Writer
original_name: คุณปู่วุ่น Y หลานชาย Y วุ่น
overview: Grandpa Somsak, a once-famous adventure novelist, is facing a severe financial crisis. He's being pressured by the bank to pay a 12 million baht debt. If he doesn't pay this debt, his Saeng Karun Orphanage Foundation may have to close down. And one of the solutions he's considering is something Somsak would never have imagined in his lifetime!

trailers.title: [OFFICIAL TRAILER] Grandpa's Troubles Y, Grandson's Troubles Y
